findings.issue: אָדָם is a common masculine singular noun, not a proper name; Adam names one man and leaves the common noun untranslated.
סַפַּחַת is a scab (an attached crust); erupción adds a breaking-out.
בַהֶרֶת is a bright spot; mancha is a generic stain and drops the brightness.
צָרַעַת is a common noun, not a name; tsaráat leaves it untranslated.

notes: Skin-of-his-flesh twice, the hophal bringing, and Aarón the priest or one from his sons the priests match the tokens.
